url.description: Full git repository URL (https:// or git@). The .git suffix is optional. The CLI accepts an empty string too.

ref.description: Git branch or tag to use. Defaults to the repository default branch. The CLI accepts an empty string too.

sha.description: Full 40-character git commit SHA pinning an exact version. When both ref and sha are set, sha is the effective pin. Docs say '40-character'; the CLI additionally requires lowercase hex.
